# AAC Library

> A free, zero-auth REST API for searching and downloading symbols from this AAC
> (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) library, enriched with keywords and
> category tags. No API key. CORS is open to all origins and responses are cached
> at the edge.

Base URL: https://nleverenz.github.io/icons

## Search API (recommended)

`GET /api/search?q={query}&vendor={set}&limit={n}&offset={n}`

- `q` — keyword query; ranked match over icon name + tags (prefix + fuzzy). Alias: `name`.
- `vendor` — optional set id (currently just `aac`).
- `limit` — page size, default 100, max 500.
- `offset` — pagination offset, default 0.

Returns one result per logical icon (variants grouped). Each item:
`{ id, vendor, name, description, tags[], download (image url), url (icon page), variants: [{ name, properties, download }] }`

Example:

```
curl "https://nleverenz.github.io/icons/api/search?q=muffin&limit=2"
```

## Other endpoints

- `GET /api` — list every icon file (each variant is a separate item). Filter with `vendor` and `q` (substring on name).
- `GET /api/vendors` — metadata for every set: id, name, version, count, and variant axes.

## Integration notes

- No authentication. All endpoints accept `GET` and return JSON.
- Responses set `Cache-Control: s-maxage=3600, stale-while-revalidate=86400`.
- The `download` field points directly at the image file.

## Docs

- [API Reference](https://nleverenz.github.io/icons/docs): full human-readable documentation with parameter tables and example responses.
